profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker CDNS. Its SEC filing identifier is 0000813672. On its own site the company describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider that delivers hardware, software, and IP for electronic design.

The same site text speaks to the company's culture and sustainability work, citing Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work and its investment in sustainability. The material does not name specific AI products or describe an AI position in any further detail.

Litigation records for the company list 281 cases in California.
